bullets.title: MU: Earnings Tonight — Beat/Raise Consensus, HBM4 Momentum, $50B+ Capex Guide
bullets.body: Micron reports after close today with sell-side widely expecting a beat-and-raise. Jefferies models FQ1 EPS guide ~$37 vs. Street $35.55 and GM ~88% vs. Street 87.2%; JPM MI expects F1Q27 revenue guide well above Street consensus ($56.3B), driven by DRAM/NAND ASPs +20% QoQ, HBM4 shipments >$1B, and DC SSD revenue >$5B. GS TMT and Citi both flag Nov-qtr guide of $38-40 vs. consensus $36, with FY27 capex expected at $50B+; CY27 EPS view from Jefferies is $215-225 vs. Street $171.

bullets.title: MDB: GS Raises PT to $520 on Atlas Momentum; LT Growth Targets Nudged Higher
bullets.body: Post-Investor Day, Goldman raises MDB PT to $520 (54% upside) as management lifted LT revenue growth to 20%+ (from high-teens) and Atlas growth to mid-20% (from 20%+); Atlas AI-native cohort growing 165% YoY. Dev Ittycheria's return as CEO viewed as stabilizing after CJ Desai departure; the 20% recent sell-off seen as attractive entry. D.A. Davidson and DA Davidson both maintain Buy; Mizuho notes MDB TAM growing 12% CAGR to ~$200B by 2030.

bullets.title: HOOD: KeyBanc Raises PT to $140 (OW) on Agentic AI, Perpetual Futures, Prediction Markets
bullets.body: KeyBanc raises HOOD PT to $140 from prior on ~15 platform updates unveiled at HOOD Summit: native AI agent experience (150K+ existing agentic users), earnings prediction contracts, and perpetual futures via Bitstamp across 8 crypto assets. FY26 revenue estimate raised to $5,346M and FY27 to $7,042M. Morgan Stanley and GS TMT both positive on the announcements; stock +3.8% pre-market.

bullets.title: CCL: Multiple Houses Raise PTs After 3Q Beat; 2027 Bookings at Record Levels
bullets.body: Carnival 3Q adj. EPS $1.43 beat Street $1.34; EBITDA $2.99B beat guided $2.88B. Citi maintains Buy, raises FY26 EPS to $2.24, PT $35; Mizuho lowers PT to $38 from $39 on fuel; MS raises PT to $32.50 with FY26e EPS $2.28; GS upgrades to $32 PT on 2027 yield tailwinds. Over 50% of 2027 already booked at record pricing/occupancy; onboard spend accelerated to +7.7% in Q3 vs +5.2% Q2. Deferred revenue up 7% YoY despite 0% capacity growth.

bullets.title: AAPL: Oct 13 Smart-Home Product Launch — J490 Hub, HomePod Mini, TV Set-Top Box
bullets.body: Apple will unveil its smart-home market push on October 13, including the J490 hub device, an updated HomePod mini, and a new TV set-top box, all manufactured in Vietnam via BYD partnership. An advanced tabletop robot with iPad-like display is expected in 2027. Jefferies notes ~6M iPhone Duo units expected in 2026 with Foxconn assembly yield just above 60%, flagging launch-supply risk for Oct 16 pre-orders.

bullets.title: NBIS: William Blair Initiates Outperform; 12-Year 50MW Data Center Deal with AIB
bullets.body: William Blair initiates Nebius Group (NBIS $237.36) at Outperform. Separately, NBIS signed a binding 12-year, 50MW AI data center capacity agreement at AIB's southeastern US facility; customer prepayments fund substantial initial development, limiting equity dilution. Stock +1.0% pre-market.

bullets.title: HPE: Networking Day Upside — $1.2B AMD Helios Order, Juniper Synergies to $800M
bullets.body: HPE's Networking Day guided DC Networking revenue at low-to-high 50s% CAGR through FY29 and raised FY27 Networking segment growth outlook to high-teens to low-20s%. Juniper cost synergy target raised to $800M annual run-rate (from $600M) by end FY28. HPE secured a $1.2B order from Vultr for AMD Helios AI Rack systems. Stock +4.9% pre-market; Citi rates Buy.

bullets.title: DKNG: Prediction Market Spend to Exceed $200-300M Prior Guidance; EBITDA Below Target
bullets.body: DraftKings is pulling forward prediction market investment from FY27 into FY26, with total FY26 PM spend expected to exceed the prior $200-300M guidance range given better-than-expected LTV/CAC economics. Total FY26 adj. EBITDA now likely below the $700-900M guidance range. Core OSB handle tracking +15% YoY through first two NFL weeks; long-term 30%+ EBITDA margin confidence reiterated. JPM maintains Overweight.

bullets.title: META: Muse for SMB Launches; Integrates with Asana, Slack, Intuit, Canva
bullets.body: META launched Muse for Small Business integrating with Asana, Zoom, Intuit, Box, Canva, and Slack; remains top free download on Apple App Store. Citi's mid-week note highlights META's Muse rollout as key driver for hyperscaler basket (+2% past month) and recommends buying hyperscalers ahead of earnings on cash flow upside. Hedgeye flags META as bullish trend (buy $681, sell $795).

bullets.title: TLN: $3B Buyback Auth Including $1.5B ASR; CEO Transition to Terry Nutt Jan 1
bullets.body: Talen Energy announces $3B new buyback authorization including a $1.5B accelerated share repurchase, signaling strong cash flow confidence. CEO transition from Mac McFarland to Terry Nutt effective January 1, 2027 viewed as planned/strategic continuity. GS flags as bullish; stock down 1.5% pre-market on broader market action.

bullets.title: TSLA: Q3 Deliveries Forecast 441K (-11% Y/Y); FCF Negative, $30B Credit Arranged
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley models Tesla Q3 deliveries at 441K (-11% YoY, -8% QoQ) on tough 3Q25 comp, softer US/China demand, mixed EU trends. Energy storage deployments expected at 16.3 GWh (+30% YoY) but margins below historical levels. Tesla separately arranged a $30B credit package as free cash flow turned negative. Hedgeye flags TSLA as bearish trend (buy $346, sell $380).

bullets.title: ABNB: AI Search Coming Fall Update; Unlocks Sponsored Listings Monetization
bullets.body: JPM Tech Sketch notes ABNB's AI Search feature is coming in its fall product update, which unlocks a Sponsored Listings monetization path described as having huge incremental margin potential. Analyst suggests ABNB should not be in 'AI Agentic Losers' baskets given this upcoming catalyst.

bullets.title: SHOP: Pursuing Money Transmitter License; New 1.25% Payment Fee Adds GP$ Upside
bullets.body: Jefferies notes SHOP is pursuing nationwide money transmitter licensure, seen as a 2028 gross profit and EBIT tailwind. UBS details a new 1.25% premium fee for merchants using third-party processors alongside Shopify Payments (launched July 2026); each 1% incremental volume adds ~1.5-2.0bps to overall GP take rate. Shopify Payments penetration at 68% in Q2, with Shop Pay GMV +53% YoY to ~$41B.

bullets.title: MNDY: JPM Downgrades to Neutral, PT $87 on Growth Challenges and SMB Softness
bullets.body: JPM Tech Sketch downgrades Monday.com from Overweight to Neutral with PT cut to $87 (from $90) citing growth challenges, lengthening sales cycles, and SMB softness. OpenAI's Dots agentic assistant creates additional competitive pressure alongside META Muse on project management workflows.

bullets.title: GLW: AT&T $3B+ LTA and Verizon 80M-Mile Agreement Extend Optical Visibility
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley (EW, $165 PT) notes Corning secured AT&T commitment of $3B+ and Verizon securing 80M+ fiber miles through 2032, plus an NVDA-backed 15,000 route-mile expansion through 2030. Enterprise segment +65% YoY on AI demand from Meta, Amazon, NVDA. GLW increasing capex $800M YoY; incremental margins expected to cycle below average for two quarters before recovering as capacity ramps.

bullets.title: DIS: JPM Maintains OW, $137 PT; FY27 Growth Front-Half Weighted, ESPN DTC Price Hike
bullets.body: JPM models DIS FY26 adj. EPS $6.71 (+13.3% YoY) and FY27 $7.48 (+11.4% YoY), with management guiding double-digit adj. EPS growth. FY27 growth skewed to first half from holiday shifts and theatrical slate. ESPN Unlimited price increased to $31.99/mo; Disney+ ad-free raised $2.50 to $21.49/mo. F4Q26 Sports OI expected +43% YoY on rights-cost normalization. FY27 SVOD OI margin lowered to 12.2% on higher international investment.

bullets.title: NVDA: Record Buyback Signals Confidence; Data Center Digital Twin Deal with Jacobs
bullets.body: NVDA's record share buyback announced last quarter underscores management confidence in valuation per OPCO. Separately, Jacobs was selected to deploy a Data Center Digital Twin for a large-scale NVDA U.S. R&D facility under a 3-year SaaS agreement built on NVDA Omniverse libraries. Hedgeye flags NVDA as bullish trend (buy $218, sell $233).

bullets.title: AMZN: Biggest Mega-Cap Tech Positioning Deterioration; Ad Business Facing Agent Disruption
bullets.body: Jefferies flags AMZN as seeing the largest deterioration in Mega Cap Tech positioning over the last few weeks, driven by consumer data deterioration and agent impact concerns on its ~$80B ad business. Anthropic routing 47% of sales through AMZN and GOOGL cloud partners, providing partial offset. Hedgeye flags AMZN as bearish trend (buy $241, sell $255).

bullets.title: HUT: On Track to Exceed 1 GW Contracted Capacity; AI/Data Center Pivot Accelerating
bullets.body: MS road note: HUT management expects to reach and exceed 2026 target of 1 GW contracted capacity this year. ~700 MW of existing mining footprint available for repurposing to higher-value AI/data-center uses; Vega site cooling 205 MW of ASIC capacity at 200 kW rack density using direct-to-liquid cooling. $1B revolver and crypto HODL provide financial flexibility; management flagged 'more to come' on site conversions.

bullets.title: TSM: 2027 Revenue Growth Raised to 39%; A14 Yield Running 2-3 Quarters Ahead of Schedule
bullets.body: JPM raises TSMC 2027 revenue growth estimate to 39% (from 35%), driven by ~25% blended ASP increase with N3/N2 leading edge up ~10%. A14 yield progress running 2-3 quarters ahead of schedule with ~$1.8B A14 revenue modeled in 2H28. 3Q26 revenue modeled at $45.8B (+14% QoQ, high-end of guide); 4Q26 guidance expected +10-12% QoQ.
